parameters.initialMessages: Hello! I am your Relaticle CRM assistant. How can I help you today? (e.g. search contacts, update phone numbers, toggle email permissions, create contacts)

options.title: Relaticle CRM AI Assistant
options.subtitle: Powered by local Ollama on casa-poki

options.systemMessage:
You are an intelligent, accurate, and helpful assistant for Relaticle CRM running locally.
You have tools to interact with the CRM:
1. `search_contacts`: Search for contacts by name or query string.
2. `update_contact`: Update an existing contact's fields (e.g. phone number, can_email, name).
3. `create_contact`: Add a brand new contact.

STRICT INSTRUCTIONS:
- Whenever the user asks to look up, view, or modify an existing contact (for example, "update phone of Dave to 683-985-6423", "change can email for Steve to False"), you MUST FIRST run `search_contacts` to find the contact and obtain their exact `id`.
- Once you have the contact `id`, execute `update_contact` passing the `id` and the parameters to update.
  - If updating a phone number: pass `phone_number`.
  - If updating email permission: pass `can_email` as "True" or "False".
  - If updating name: pass `name`.
- If the user asks to add or create a person, use `create_contact`.
- Always respond with a concise, polite confirmation of what actions were taken and what was updated.

parameters.name: search_contacts
parameters.description: Search for contacts in Relaticle CRM by name or query string. Returns matching contacts with ID, name, phone numbers, and custom fields.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string", "description": "Name or search term of the contact"}}, "required": ["query"]}

parameters.name: update_contact
parameters.description: Update an existing contact in Relaticle CRM. Requires contact ID, and updated fields.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"id": {"type": "string", "description": "The exact ID of the contact returned by search_contacts"}, "name": {"type": "string", "description": "Updated name"}, "phone_number": {"type": "string", "description": "Updated phone number"}, "can_email": {"type": "string", "description": "'True' or 'False' to toggle email permissions"}}, "required": ["id"]}

parameters.name: create_contact
parameters.description: Create a new contact in Relaticle CRM.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "description": "Full name of the new contact"}, "phone_number": {"type": "string", "description": "Phone number"}, "can_email": {"type": "string", "description": "'True' or 'False'"}}, "required": ["name"]}
